items.lede: SynthID Detector will flag content created with AI tools from OpenAI, Google, Apple and other companies.
items.title: Google's AI detection website is now available

items.lede: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI.
items.title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media

items.lede: The new SynthID website can now identify AI content from Google, OpenAI, and more.
items.title: Google rolls out improved SynthID AI content detector, now available globally
